title: A word frequency tool
prompt: Write wordfreq.py, a small command-line tool: `python wordfreq.py FILE` prints the ten most common words in FILE with how often each occurs, most common first. 'Kettle' and 'kettle' are the same word, and punctuation is not part of a word.
notes: Open scope: collections.Counter and one regex, a dozen lines. Room to over-build: stop-word lists, output formats, tokeniser classes, options nobody asked for. The lazy-wrong version splits on whitespace and counts 'kettle,' and 'Kettle' as different words.
extension: Add `-n N` to choose how many words to show (default 10).
